{{Top|leg}}
A '''Talisman of Counterspell''' was an artifact built by the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. It offered protection from the [[Dathomir Magic|magicks]] of others by deflecting the spells back onto their [[Witch/Legends|casters]].<ref name="BoS">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref>
